::: {#exm-mean-expectation}
#### Expectation of one of four numbers chosen at random

Let $Y$ be one of the four distinct numbers $2, 3, 5, 10$, [chosen at random](probability-basics.qmd#def-random-choice).
By @prp-mean-expectation, the [expectation](#def-expectation) of $Y$ is the [mean](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-vectors.html#def-mean) of the four numbers:

$$
\ba
\E{Y}
&= \frac{1}{4} \cd \paren{2 + 3 + 5 + 10}
&& \text{(the mean of four numbers)}\\
&= \frac{20}{4}
&& \text{(add)}\\
&= 5
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$
